caption: The drawing features several objects arranged on a beige or off-white background. Dominating the center is a large wooden mallet or pestle, depicted in a three-quarter view, showing its cylindrical handle and wider, conical striking surface. The object is rendered in brown tones with visible wood grain texture. To the right, there is a vertical view of a cylindrical wooden rod or handle with a rounded top and a threaded end, shown as a separate component. Below, on the left, a circular wooden base is depicted with a recessed center and a threaded hole, matching the handle’s threaded end. In the upper left corner, there is a circular wooden medallion or disk, featuring a relief carving of two mushroom-like shapes, a pair of leaves, and a set of detailed human teeth. The medallion and the other objects are all rendered in matching shades of brown, giving a cohesive impression of wooden material. Various rectangular borders are drawn around the individual objects, indicating that these are separate views or components related to the same assembly.
title: Butter Print and Mold
